schema:name: Shared Health Record
schema:description:
This component manages the storage, access, and exchange of clinical documents, diagnostic reports, and structured health data shared among care team members. It conforms to FHIR-based standards to ensure interoperability and consistent data representation.

The purpose of this component is to provide a common, standards-based repository of patient information that all authorized care team members can access and contribute to. It supports continuity and completeness of the shared clinical picture.

Example: Lab results, imaging reports, and care plans uploaded by different providers are consolidated within the shared health record and made accessible to the full care team through the collaboration platform.
